title: Raye Leads 2027 Grammy Nominations With 11 Nods as Beyoncé Reaches Milestone

Rosalía and Miranda Lambert Score Big in 2027 Grammy Nods
spot: English singer-songwriter Raye leads the 2027 Grammy Award nominations with 11 nods, tying Beyoncé's record, while Beyoncé captures her 100th career nomination ahead of the February ceremony.
content_html:
Key Developments

The Recording Academy announced the nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards on Monday, revealing that English singer-songwriter Raye leads the pack with 11 nods. Riding the success of her critically acclaimed album "This Music May Contain Hope," Raye secured nominations in the major categories of record, song, and album of the year for the first time in her career. She is also recognized for songwriter of the year non-classical, various pop categories, and music video, tying Beyoncé's 2025 record for the most nominations in a single year by a female artist.

Beyoncé extended her reign as the most-nominated artist in Grammy history by securing her 100th career nod for "Morning Dew (Donk)" in the R&B solo performance category. Spanish singer Rosalía followed closely behind with nine nominations, including first-time nods in record, song, and album of the year following her Latin Grammy win for "Lux." Miranda Lambert, Olivia Rodrigo, Phoebe Bridgers, and first-time nominee Ella Langley each earned seven nominations.

The 2027 Grammy Awards are scheduled to air live on ABC from the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on February 7 at 7 p.m. Eastern, marking the show's return to the network for the first time since 1972. The ceremony will also stream on Disney+ and Hulu, with the final round of voting running from December 10 to January 7.

Key Takeaways

  • Raye leads all artists with 11 nominations, scoring her first-ever nods in the major categories of record, song, and album of the year.
  • Beyoncé reached a historic milestone by securing her 100th career Grammy nomination in the R&B solo performance category.
  • The 2027 Grammy Awards ceremony will broadcast live on ABC from Los Angeles on February 7, and stream on Disney+ and Hulu.

Why It Matters

The 2027 Grammy nominations highlight a shifting landscape in contemporary music, showcasing record-breaking achievements for both emerging stars like Raye and historic powerhouses like Beyoncé. Raye's dominance reflects the massive commercial and critical impact of her recent work, while Rosalía's strong showing underscores the expanding global reach of avant-garde and Latin music categories. Additionally, the broadcast's move back to ABC for the first time in over five decades marks a notable television milestone for the Recording Academy's flagship event.
